body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.55) that: Asian Paints Q3 FY27 standalone operating margin is ≥20.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (Nov-2026): Q2 'a little bit of a soft quarter' on mix; H1 PBDIT margin 19.6% ('higher range of the overall band'); H1 volume ~8%, value ~16% (price increases). MD Amit Syngle: for the year 'we should be able to maintain the band… 18% to 20%' via price calibration, cost-excellence programme and VAE in-house intermediates. Screener standalone OPM: Sep-25 18%, Dec-25 21%, Mar-26 21%, Jun-26 22%, Sep-26 17%. Reasoning: Q3 is seasonally the strongest margin quarter and price hikes are flowing, but input inflation is the highest in years and the full-year band (18–20%) with H1 at 19.6% implies H2 near 19%. 20%+ in Q3 needs a strong mix. Resolution: YES if Q3 FY27 standalone Operating Profit ÷ Sales from screener.in (standalone view) ≥20.0%; company-reported standalone PBDIT margin used as tiebreak if screener is unavailable. Source: screener.in Asian Paints standalone quarterly; company Q3 FY27 press release. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: Seasonality base: Asian Paints' Dec quarter standalone OPM has been ≥20% in roughly half to 60% of recent years.
